contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman copper alloy contemporary cast copy of an As issued for Nero (54-68 AD), Lugdunum mint, 66-67 AD, Reece Period 3 (54-68 AD). Reverse: Victory advancing left, holding shield inscribed [SPQR], S C across fields. Cf. RIC I Nero 545, 605. Weight: 9.13g. Diameter: 27.37mm
